name: Remchingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided white over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Remchingen (a rose between crossed swords and fleurs-de-lis on red).
history: Municipal flag of Remchingen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Remchingen arms — rose, swords and fleurs-de-lis on red
